title: FliHub Phase 1G walkthrough — mobile scorekeeping
note: Silent walkthrough — narration scripted (recordings/narration-phase1g.md). Record with `npm run record:walkthrough-1g`. Actual per-run offsets land in recordings/output/run-manifest-1g.json. Phone-sized viewport; the scorekeeper is on camera, intervening holes are prefilled with fictional scores off-camera.

scenes.title: The assigned scorekeeper opens the event: rounds, group, teams, athletes
Hole 1 draft entry, a blank score blocks submission, then Round 1 submits
Intermission, then Round 2 · 9 holes · Blue — displayed hole 10 is physical hole 1
Later in the round: final scores on hole 18, Round 2 submitted
